intro.text: Spren that gather around chasmfiends. Now and then one drifts away and vanishes in a puff of smoke.

description.text: When a chasmfiend dies, its remaining luckspren leave the same way. Few people know these are luckspren.

In Shadesmar they are called mandras and are much larger, with long bodies and arrow-shaped heads. Spren harness them to pull ships, several per ship, because they keep dropping into the Physical Realm.
Larkin and other greatshells bond them as they grow, which lets them get far bigger than they otherwise could.
